question:
Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word.

Stratified
solution:
The correct answer is** 'Laminated'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The given word** 'Stratified'** means arranged in layers or classes. **('स्तरीकृत' or 'परतदार')**.

 
 
• **Example: **The society was highly stratified and firmly structured.
 
 
 
• **'Laminated'** means something is covered with layers of material. It can also refer to a structure composed of multiple layers.** ('परतदार' or 'स्तरबद्ध')**.
 
 
• **Example:** The laminated structure of the rock was clear to see.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is **'option 3'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **'Scattered' **means distributed or occurring at widely spaced and irregular intervals in time or space. ('विकिरण' or 'बिखरा हुआ').
 
• **'Consolidated' **means brought together into a single whole. ('संगठित' or 'एकीकृत').
 
• **'Ungraded' **means not arranged in order by grade. ('अवर्गीकृत').
